findings.reason: _cited_file catches RuntimeError (Path.resolve on a symlink loop, Python 3.10-3.12) as 'unreadable: symlink loop'; cites only normalizes text and resolves nothing.
Fallback reads annotation-only names (x: int) like ast does; RETRIES and Store::label added to the parity fixture.
ast walks Match case bodies, ast.TypeAlias (getattr, 3.12+) and tuple/list/starred targets; the fallback reads unpacking, chained assignments and type lines.

A dotted token counts as a path only with a directory part or a known extension that is not a product name (_MC_EXTENSIONS/_MC_NOT_FILES); os.path::join, System.IO::File, v2.0::x, node.js::fs are skipped.
Fallback scans statement starts only: a light lexer skips lines inside brackets, strings and backslash continuations; keyword names are ignored.
_safe_read did not strip a BOM; _cited_file now drops a leading U+FEFF before ast or the line scan.
Test now emulates a case-insensitive disk by patching os.listdir, so the per-segment comparison is proven on Linux too (CI also runs windows-latest and macos-latest).
docs/UPGRADING.md gains a strict-lint section for the OAW-21 warning.

oaw_common.lf_sha256 + HASH_BASIS (CRLF folded to LF, cross-checked against evals/egm-pilot file_digest) built and used by resolver_sha256; the LF byte count and workspace-root normalization stay unbuilt and are recorded in CHANGELOG.

tests/test_cli_resolve.py is in 6481437 (148 lines); 337-293 = 44 = 6 cli_resolve + 13 improvement + 9 context_hub + 16 wiki_sync POSIX tests; other units were reviewed in their own packets (packet-builder scope, see EV-09).
_load_knowledge_pages already stores 'content' (scripts/wiki_sync.py _load_knowledge_pages, unchanged by the diff); the manual-page citation tests exercise it.
Only fenced code is skipped by design: indented blocks need CommonMark list context to detect; documented in Wiki_Sync_Guide (put examples in a fence) and the _iter_code_citations docstring.
cites uses lint's loader, so invalid raw metadata stops both with the same error (exit 1, no traceback); pinned by a test and documented in CLI_Reference.
openai_key needs a sk-proj-/sk-svcacct-/sk-admin-/sk-None- kind or a legacy alphanumeric run with a digit and no trailing hyphen; kebab-case prose negatives added.

First-character lookahead replaced by whole-placeholder exemptions (${X}, $UPPER, {x}, {{x}}, %s, %(x)s, ***), so $ecret is refused; literal user:pass/password stays refused because the approved OAW-12 design requires doc examples to use placeholders.
URL scheme bounded to 32 characters and JWT start anchored outside a base64url run (also quadratic); 120,000-character adversarial notes scan in about 0.3 s instead of minutes.
aws_access_key wrapped in (?<![A-Za-z0-9])...(?![A-Za-z0-9]); embedded-in-blob and 17-character negatives added.
No in-repo importer besides the CLI (grep); annotate already raised ValueError for invalid or meta topics. Docstrings and CLI_Reference now state the ValueError for Python callers.
--index refuses a query containing a line break; memory header date and tag are cut to 40 characters like the 120-character title.
Verified: the byte-golden test passes unchanged against 790177e scripts/context_hub.py and oaw_common.py; the provenance and re-check method are recorded in the test.

_page_title is pre-existing (scripts/context_hub.py _page_title, unchanged by the diff) and its frontmatter, heading and file-name fallbacks are asserted by test_recall_index_knowledge_page_row_uses_title_and_matched_line.

Packet-builder artifact, not a code defect: shared files (harness_check.py, CHANGELOG, docs, oaw_common.py) were diffed whole, so other groups' units appeared; they were reviewed in their own packets. Next packet builder should filter shared-file hunks by group.
Every negative fixture must also pass evidence_write_refusal as a whole; prose false-positive fixtures (sk-learn-..., placeholders) added.
A resource regression over an incomplete baseline is listed as uncertain_resource_regressions and the verdict is inconclusive; over a complete baseline it still rejects.
Added the incomplete-baseline case (complete and incomplete candidate, old == 0 path, pass gain).
SELF_IMPROVEMENT: overhead_tokens is a token count; cost_usd and latency_ms are the runner's totals and must include the overhead; the coverage block covers all metrics deliberately.
Exact decimal comparison was already documented (0.667 needs 3 of 3); added to CLI_Reference and pinned with a subtest.
The test now captures decide's fresh comparison and asserts the vacuous reason with no other regression or failed check.

A version/feature field would be ignored by older copies too (they validate only schema_version and their own fields) and OAW-04 rules out a schema bump; documented how to recognise older-copy comparisons and that enforcing decide fails closed.

Kept lexical by decision: it confines the shim's text; links inside node_modules are trusted like the package code (writers there can already rewrite shim or script), and realpath would refuse every npm link package. Reasoning in code and CHANGELOG; pinned by a symlink test.

platform selects the shim policy only; paths use the host os.path because files are read on the host. Windows parsing runs on the windows-latest CI job (and locally on Windows); documented in resolve_cli.
Runner and manifest wiring (cli_argv, resolver_sha256, hash_basis) is recorded in CHANGELOG as deferred to the new eval registrations; frozen contracts unchanged.
tests/test_cli_resolve.py is in 6481437 (6 POSIX tests + 1 Windows junction test); the +44 floor is 6 + 13 + 9 + 16 across the four new-test modules (see CT-10).
resolver_sha256 documents that only the marked block is hashed and that manifests also record the Python version.
